conclusions: Both configured model-service interfaces are blocked at the usable HTTP connection/response layer in the observed local network path.
There is an evidenced local client-network factor: an enabled loopback system proxy and a common tunnel route for both service addresses.
Bypassing the urllib application proxy did not recover either interface. The test does not prove that the local proxy alone is the cause or that changing proxy configuration would fix it.
Fast TCP establishment through a tunnel is not proof of a successful end-to-end service HTTP connection.
No endpoint authentication result was obtained; no conclusion about key validity, selected model identity, or model weights is supported.

A client tunnel/upstream path failure and a shared remote gateway/service failure remain distinguishable only with additional independent network evidence, which was not sought in this bounded diagnosis.
